test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

ZYWT, XWUR, VUSP, ?, RQOL
solution:
Alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

**Alphabets are decreased by - 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dda156fc158b1b68e05588f2914962510d850f483c39805d59a049fce9679eb5.png] 

So, **'TSQN' **will replace the question mark in the given series**.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
